data.description: A scarab beetle deals 1 point of Strength damage on a successful bite. This damage is doubled against creatures with no armor or natural armor, but creatures in heavy armor or with a natural armor bonus of +lO or greater are immune, as are creatures immune to critical hits or without flesh.
